title: The formal letter
goal: Write a complete formal letter in the Canadian format: layout, subject line, opening, structured body, request and closing formula.

steps.title: A letter to the city
steps.intro: Sofia lives in Gatineau. The main path in her local park has no lighting, and it gets dark early in the fall. She writes a formal letter to the city. Look at the **layout** first, then read the content.

blocks.title: Sofia's letter
blocks.context: A formal request to a municipal department.
blocks.fr:
Sofia Moreno
45, rue Laurier, app. 3
Gatineau (Québec)  J8X 3V8

Gatineau, le 17 octobre 2026

Service des travaux publics
Ville de Gatineau

Objet : Demande d'éclairage au parc des Cèdres

Madame, Monsieur,

Je me permets de vous écrire au sujet du parc des Cèdres, situé à côté de mon domicile. Depuis le début de l'automne, il fait nuit dès 18 h 30 ; or, le sentier principal du parc n'est pas éclairé.

Cette situation est dangereuse. En effet, de nombreux résidents traversent le parc le soir pour rentrer de l'arrêt d'autobus. Le mois dernier, une de mes voisines y est tombée et s'est blessée au poignet. De plus, plusieurs parents n'osent plus laisser leurs enfants revenir seuls de l'école.

C'est pourquoi je vous serais reconnaissante de bien vouloir étudier la possibilité d'installer des lampadaires le long du sentier. Vous trouverez ci-joint une pétition signée par 85 résidents du quartier.

Je vous remercie de l'attention que vous porterez à ma demande et je reste à votre disposition pour toute information complémentaire.

Dans l'attente de votre réponse, je vous prie d'agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de mes salutations distinguées.

Sofia Moreno

p. j. Pétition (2 pages)
blocks.en: Sofia Moreno, 45 Laurier Street, Apt. 3, Gatineau, Québec J8X 3V8. Gatineau, October 17, 2026. Public Works Department, City of Gatineau. Subject: Request for lighting in Parc des Cèdres. Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to you about Parc des Cèdres, located next to my home. Since the beginning of fall, it has been dark from 6:30 p.m.; however, the main path in the park is not lit. This situation is dangerous. Indeed, many residents cross the park in the evening on their way home from the bus stop. Last month, one of my neighbours fell there and injured her wrist. What's more, several parents no longer dare to let their children come home from school alone. That's why I would be grateful if you could look into the possibility of installing streetlights along the path. Please find attached a petition signed by 85 residents of the neighbourhood. Thank you for considering my request; I remain available for any further information. Looking forward to your reply, yours sincerely, Sofia Moreno. Encl.: Petition (2 pages)

blocks.prompt: Where does Sofia state the purpose of her letter for the first time?
blocks.explain: The [[Objet]] line tells the reader what the letter is about **before** they read it. The first paragraph then gives the context.

blocks.prompt: How many paragraphs does the body of the letter have (between the opening and the closing)?
blocks.explain: Each paragraph has **one job**, just like in lesson 1: context → problem with proof → request → thanks. Then comes the closing formula.

blocks.prompt: What does “p. j.” at the bottom mean?
blocks.explain: [[p. j.]] = [[pièce jointe]]: Sofia includes the petition. A post-scriptum is [[P.-S.]], and it doesn't belong in a formal letter.

blocks.note: In a real letter, write [[reconnaissant]] (man) or [[reconnaissante]] (woman), not both. [[bien vouloir]] + infinitive adds politeness: *kindly*.

blocks.title: Afin de: a formal pour
blocks.note: [[afin de]] means the same as [[pour]] + infinitive (*in order to*), but it sounds more formal. Use it once or twice in a letter, not in every sentence.

examples.fr: Je vous écris afin de signaler un problème de chauffage.
examples.en: I am writing in order to report a heating problem.

examples.fr: Afin de mieux vous servir, nous avons modifié nos heures d'ouverture.
examples.en: In order to serve you better, we have changed our opening hours.

blocks.title: Words and formulas for this lesson
The Canadian format
blocks.body:
- **Everything on the left.** In Canada, letters are usually written in *bloc* style: sender, date, recipient and signature all aligned on the left. In France, the recipient's address often goes on the right.
- **Addresses:** a comma after the civic number, and the province in parentheses in Québec style: [[45, rue Laurier, app. 3]], [[Gatineau (Québec)  J8X 3V8]]. Canada Post puts two spaces before the postal code. Apartment = [[app.]]
- **The date:** [[Gatineau, le 17 octobre 2026]] or simply [[Le 17 octobre 2026]]. No capital on the month, no *the 17th*: just the number (except [[le 1er]]).
- **Shorter closings in Québec:** Québec style guides accept simpler formulas: [[Veuillez agréer, Madame, mes salutations distinguées.]] or [[Je vous prie de recevoir, Monsieur, mes meilleures salutations.]] The long France-style formula ([[Je vous prie d'agréer… l'expression de mes sentiments distingués]]) is still correct, but sounds old-fashioned to many Canadians.
- **Emails:** in a formal email in Canada, [[Bonjour Madame Tremblay,]] is very common, and you can close with [[Salutations distinguées]] or [[Meilleures salutations]]. [[Cordialement]] is common in France and increasingly in Canada.

blocks.title: Formal letter mistakes
blocks.body:
- **Cher Monsieur to a stranger:** [[Cher Monsieur]] / [[Chère Madame]] are for people you know. For a stranger or an organization: [[Madame, Monsieur,]]
- **The name after Madame:** in a letter, write [[Madame,]] alone, not *Madame Tremblay,* (that's fine in an email with [[Bonjour]]).
- **A capital after the opening:** after [[Madame, Monsieur,]], the first sentence starts with a capital letter on a new line.
- **Mixing formulas:** the closing must **repeat the opening exactly**: if you wrote [[Madame,]], close with [[Veuillez agréer, Madame, …]].
- **Too casual:** no [[Salut]], no [[tu]], no [[bref]], no abbreviations like [[svp]] or [[bcp]]. Write [[s'il vous plaît]] or, better, [[je vous prie de…]].
- **Cordialement alone in a letter:** on paper, a one-word closing is too short. Use a full formula.
- **Suite à:** very common in Canada and in offices, but criticized by many teachers. In an exam, prefer [[À la suite de…]].

blocks.title: Exam link: TEF writing, section B
blocks.body:
In the TEF Canada writing test, the second task (*section B*) asks you to **give and defend your point of view** on a statement, often in the form of a **letter** (to a newspaper, an organization or a company) or a message on a forum. You have **35 minutes** to write **200 to 250 words**.

When the task asks for a letter, examiners check that you respect the **genre**: an appropriate opening, a clear structure in paragraphs, and a closing formula. You won't lose many points for a missing address, but you will for a letter that starts with [[Salut]] and has no paragraphs.

**Practice:** *Un journal local a publié un article affirmant que les parcs devraient fermer à 20 h pour des raisons de sécurité. Vous écrivez au journal pour donner votre opinion.* Spend three to five minutes on a plan: (1) why you are writing and your position, (2)–(4) three arguments, each with an example, (5) your proposal and the closing formula. Always check the current official instructions before your exam.

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: These formulas are long. Say them in chunks; they'll come out by themselves when you write.

blocks.fr: Madame, à la suite de notre conversation téléphonique du 3 octobre, je vous envoie ci-joint une copie de ma facture.
blocks.en: Madam, following our phone conversation of October 3, I am sending you attached a copy of my invoice.
blocks.explain: [[ci-joint une copie de ma facture]] = a copy of my invoice is attached.

blocks.fr: Je vous serais reconnaissant de bien vouloir me rembourser dans les meilleurs délais.
blocks.en: I would be grateful if you could refund me as soon as possible.
blocks.explain: [[me rembourser]] = to refund me; [[dans les meilleurs délais]] = as soon as possible (formal).

steps.title: Your turn
steps.intro: Think about the reader: a stranger in an office, who reads dozens of letters a day.

Too long: a subject line is a short noun phrase.

blocks.en: I am writing in order to report a noise problem.
blocks.explain: [[afin de]] + infinitive = in order to. More formal than [[pour]].

blocks.prompt: Match each formula with its place in the letter.
pairs: Je me permets de vous écrire au sujet de…

blocks.prompt: Following our conversation, I am sending you my résumé. (formal)
accept: À la suite de notre conversation, je vous envoie mon curriculum vitæ.
À la suite de notre conversation, je vous envoie mon CV.
Suite à notre conversation, je vous envoie mon CV.
Suite à notre conversation, je vous envoie mon curriculum vitæ.
À la suite de notre conversation, je vous fais parvenir mon CV.
À la suite de notre conversation, je vous envoie mon curriculum vitae.
blocks.explain: [[À la suite de]] is the safest choice in an exam. [[Suite à]] is common but criticized.

blocks.text: Je vous ___ reconnaissant de bien ___ m'envoyer les documents.
blocks.en: I would be grateful if you could send me the documents.
blocks.explain: Conditionnel [[serais]] + [[de bien vouloir]] + infinitive: the most polite way to ask.

blocks.prompt: You started your letter with “Madame,”. Which closing is correct?
options: Veuillez agréer, Madame, mes salutations distinguées.
Veuillez agréer, Monsieur, mes salutations distinguées.
blocks.explain: The closing formula **repeats the opening exactly**: [[Madame,]] → [[Veuillez agréer, Madame, …]]

blocks.prompt: Please find attached a copy of my lease.
accept: Vous trouverez ci-joint une copie de mon bail
blocks.explain: [[Vous trouverez ci-joint…]] is the classic way to mention an attachment. [[un bail]] = a lease (A2 unit 7).

blocks.text: Dans l'___ de votre réponse, je vous prie d'agréer, Monsieur, mes salutations distinguées.
blocks.en: Looking forward to your reply, yours sincerely.
blocks.explain: [[Dans l'attente de votre réponse]] = while waiting for your reply. It leads into the closing formula.

blocks.prompt: Thank you for considering my request.
accept: Je vous remercie de l'attention que vous porterez à ma demande.
Je vous remercie de l'attention portée à ma demande.
Merci de l'attention que vous porterez à ma demande.
Je vous remercie de votre attention.
Je vous remercie d'avance de l'attention que vous porterez à ma demande.
blocks.explain: Literally: *I thank you for the attention you will give to my request.* Note [[remercier de]].

blocks.fr: Je me permets de vous écrire au sujet de votre annonce.
blocks.explain: [[Je me permets de]] (reflexive) + [[au sujet de]] = regarding.

blocks.prompt: Write a formal letter. Situation: you bought a winter coat online for $249.99. When it arrived, the zipper was broken. You returned it three weeks ago, but you haven't been refunded. Write to the customer service department of the store to ask for your refund. Use the full Canadian layout.
blocks.promptFr: Écrivez une lettre au service à la clientèle pour demander un remboursement.
checklist: Paragraph 1: why you are writing (Je me permets de vous écrire au sujet de…)
Paragraph 2: the facts, with dates and a connector (en effet, de plus, cependant…)
Paragraph 3: the request (Je vous serais reconnaissant(e) de bien vouloir…) and an attachment (ci-joint)
Thanks and a closing formula that repeats the opening

models.label: Model answer
models.fr:
Karim Benali
1200, boulevard Saint-Laurent, app. 8
Montréal (Québec)  H2X 2S6

Montréal, le 17 octobre 2026

Service à la clientèle
Boutique Grand Nord

Objet : Demande de remboursement – commande no 48213

Madame, Monsieur,

Je me permets de vous écrire au sujet de ma commande du 2 septembre dernier : un manteau d'hiver au prix de 249,99 $.

À la réception du colis, j'ai constaté que la fermeture éclair était brisée. J'ai donc retourné le manteau le 25 septembre, comme l'indique votre politique de retour. Cependant, trois semaines plus tard, je n'ai toujours pas été remboursé.

C'est pourquoi je vous serais reconnaissant de bien vouloir procéder au remboursement dans les meilleurs délais. Vous trouverez ci-joint une copie du reçu de retour.

Je vous remercie de l'attention que vous porterez à ma demande. Dans l'attente de votre réponse, veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, mes salutations distinguées.

Karim Benali

p. j. Reçu de retour
models.en: Karim Benali, 1200 Saint-Laurent Blvd., Apt. 8, Montréal, Québec H2X 2S6. Montréal, October 17, 2026. Customer Service, Boutique Grand Nord. Subject: Refund request – order no. 48213. Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to you about my order of September 2: a winter coat priced at $249.99. When I received the parcel, I noticed that the zipper was broken. I therefore returned the coat on September 25, as your return policy indicates. However, three weeks later, I still have not been refunded. That's why I would be grateful if you could process the refund as soon as possible. Please find attached a copy of the return receipt. Thank you for considering my request. Looking forward to your reply, yours sincerely, Karim Benali. Encl.: Return receipt

summary:
- Lay out a formal letter the Canadian way: sender, place and date, recipient, [[Objet :]], [[Madame, Monsieur,]], body, closing, signature, [[p. j.]]
- Use the key formulas: [[Je me permets de vous écrire au sujet de…]], [[afin de]], [[Je vous serais reconnaissant(e) de bien vouloir…]], [[Vous trouverez ci-joint…]]
- Close with a formula that repeats the opening: [[Veuillez agréer, Madame, Monsieur, mes salutations distinguées.]]
